data.notes: Tokyo’s confirmed November 2026 calendar is already anchored by arena and Budokan-scale concerts, while club and festival programs are mostly not yet announced.

events.title: Nanase Aikawa 30th Anniversary ROCK KINGDOM TOUR 2026 -FINAL 日本武道館-
events.summary: Nanase Aikawa brings her 30th anniversary ROCK KINGDOM tour to a Tokyo finale at Nippon Budokan. The promoter listing confirms the November 2, 2026 date and 18:30 start.

events.title: STUTS 10th Anniversary “Alone with”
events.summary: STUTS marks his 10th anniversary with the solo live “Alone with” at Nippon Budokan. The announced guests include Campanella, 鎮座DOPENESS, Kaneee, Julia Wu, PUNPEE, Yo-Sea, tofubeats and more.

events.title: BAND-MAID WORLD TOUR 2026 FINAL
events.summary: BAND-MAID close their WORLD TOUR 2026 with two final Tokyo dates at Nippon Budokan. Creativeman confirms the November 13 and 14 performances, with the second night starting at 17:00.

events.title: Tedeschi Trucks Band - Future Soul Tour 2026
events.summary: Tedeschi Trucks Band play two Tokyo dates at SGC Hall Ariake as part of their Future Soul Tour 2026. UDO confirms November 18 and 19, 2026 performances with 19:00 starts.

events.title: 5 Seconds of Summer - EVERYONE’S A STAR! World Tour
events.summary: 5 Seconds of Summer return to Japan for a Tokyo date behind the album “Everyone’s A Star!” Creativeman confirms the November 21, 2026 show at SGC Hall Ariake with an 18:00 start.

events.title: Original Love - SOUL POWER BUDOKAN -あれから、そしてこれから- Dancin’- The 35th Anniversary Live
events.summary: Original Love celebrate their 35th anniversary with “SOUL POWER BUDOKAN” at Nippon Budokan. The J-WAVE event listing confirms the Monday, November 23, 2026 date.

events.title: 超特急 東京ドーム公演
events.summary: Japanese dance-vocal group 超特急 perform a headline Tokyo Dome show on November 25, 2026. The official listing confirms a 16:00 door time and 18:00 start.

events.title: GLAY ARENA TOUR 2026-2027 “EXOFIRE”
events.summary: GLAY bring their nationwide arena tour “EXOFIRE” to Ariake Arena for two Tokyo dates. UDO lists November 28 and 29, 2026 performances at the venue.

events.title: Hiroya Ozaki at LINE CUBE SHIBUYA
events.summary: Hiroya Ozaki performs at LINE CUBE SHIBUYA on November 29, 2026. The eplus ticket page confirms the 17:00 start and 16:00 door time.
